candidate.description: Use three 64-row LDS V regions as a ring. While exact PV consumes two regions, otherwise-idle pair-owner waves precompute the next 128 probabilities and load the next stage's first 64 V rows into the third region; after the existing barrier all waves load only the remaining 64 rows.
candidate.arithmetic: Unchanged scalar F32 QK tree, compiler expf inputs/results, ordered denominator, 512 ordered PV FMAs, gate, and BF16 store.
candidate.dispatch: one grid40/local512 launch per SWA layer

resident_gate.workload: p512/d128 eager c=1, 127 synchronized decode transitions, seven counterbalanced same-resident pairs

protocol.resident_command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_LAGUNA_F16_DECODE=fixedk PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 7 --warmup-rows 128 --compare-swa-half-stage-prefetch --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-swa-half-stage-prefetch-model-7pair.json

decision: Reject and remove. The exact overlap wins the isolated leaf but the 17,920-byte LDS increase reverses under the resident model, losing all seven pairs. Production remains the retained dense-ring all-wave V128 owner at the 21.880056 tok/s clean checkpoint.
